name: UV Volumes
definition: A framework that separates high-frequency human appearance from the 3D volume, encoding smooth densities and UV coordinates in a 3D volume and detailed appearance in a 2D Neural Texture Stack (NTS) to enable real-time, editable free-view rendering.
summary: UV Volumes is a real-time human rendering method that decouples smooth 3D geometry from high-frequency appearance, enabling editable free-view performance via a 3D feature volume and 2D Neural Texture Stack.
